title: Derived sections of an internal module with a classical underlying abelian sheaf
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] in the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Let R be a commutative ring object in condensed abelian groups, R_X its pulled-back ring object, and N an internal R_X-module [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Let G be an abelian sheaf on X_et and e:nu_X^*G ≅ N_Ab an isomorphism [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism]. In the ordinary uncompleted abelian derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], there is an isomorphism R(condensedModuleSections R X)(N[0]) ≅ RΓ(X_et,G[0]) [def-sfb-condensed-module-sections]. No torsion, finiteness or Noetherianity hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Transport an injective internal module through sectionModuleEquivalence. Lift the hom universe of X.ProEt using ULiftHom; the induced topology and pushforward equivalence transport module injectivity. Apply injective_module_abelian_acyclic on this small site and identify sheaf cohomology with right-derived evaluation. The abelian sheaf equivalence preserves injectives; compRightDerivedObjIso and the identity evaluation comparison transport the resulting vanishing back. Thus the forgotten internal injective is acyclic for evaluation at the terminal object. No claim of abelian injectivity is made.

proof.text: Use the exact forgetful functor T and evaluation F in the square (T composed with F) composed with the identity isomorphic to T composed with F. The bounded-below derived base-change comparison is invertible by step 1. Evaluate it on N[0], remove the derived identity, and use the exact-forgetful single-object comparison. The bounded-below/unbounded compatibility and the terminal-object global-sections isomorphism give R(condensedModuleSections)(N[0]) isomorphic to RΓ_proet(N_Ab[0]).

proof.text: G[0] is bounded below. Apply the existing generic source-library comparison unit theorem for abelian coefficients and map its isomorphism by etale derived global sections. Compose with comparisonLowerStarCompRightDerivedGlobalSectionsIso, the existing Leray comparison for the actual comparison morphism. The exact inverse-image single-object isomorphism and e identify its pro-etale input with N_Ab[0]. Compose with step 2, reversing the unit and Leray comparisons as necessary. This works for the zero coefficient ring and the empty scheme as well.

theorem classical_internal_module_sections
    (R : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj R] [IsCommMonObj R]
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (N : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj R X))
    (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology Ab.{u + 1})
    (e : (comparisonUpperStar Ab.{u + 1} X).obj G ≅ N.X) :
    Nonempty
      ((condensedModuleSections R X).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj N) ≅
        (Etale.rightDerivedGlobalSections Ab.{u + 1} X).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj G))
